description: Open assembly: assemblyId, assemblyName, vaultLayout, activeId, unjointedParts, and parts [{ id, name, visible, missing?, group?, instanceOf?, runState, crash? }]. unjointedParts lists part ids in no joint when the assembly has two or more parts (empty for a single part; a base part with a fixed joint is omitted). instanceOf is the definition a part instance places (insert_part instance:true): rows sharing it share one script and one run and differ in pose, name and visibility. runState is not_run_yet | ok | failed for every part, not only the active one; crash is present after a geometry engine crash on that part ({ code: geometry_worker_crashed, reason, workerRestarted, message }). Part and assembly ids are opaque surf ids, never a path or display name. No path field. featureCount and bodyCount are on status, not here. featureCount counts insert_* feature blocks, so a freehand set_script is one feature. bodyCount is null until the first run; a finished run that produced no bodies reports 0.
name: parts
